# EO Bangalore (Entrepreneurs' Organization, Bengaluru Chapter)

> EO Bangalore is the Bengaluru chapter of the Entrepreneurs' Organization (EO), a global peer-to-peer network of entrepreneurs. Founded in 2001, the chapter has grown to over 130 members from diverse industries including IT, Pharma, Manufacturing, and Real Estate, and is governed by a dedicated Board focused on fostering both professional and personal growth. Membership is open to founders, co-founders, majority shareholders, and partners. The chapter offers life-enhancing connections, shared experiences, collaborative learning, member forums, and a spousal forum.

## About

- [EO Bangalore Chapter](https://eobangalore.com/eo-bangalore): Chapter history since 2001, 130+ member community, governance, member forums, and spousal forum.
- [What is EO](https://eobangalore.com/what-is-eo): The global Entrepreneurs' Organization — opportunities at a global level, learning and networking, and building the world's most influential community of entrepreneurs.

## Membership

- [Membership](https://eobangalore.com/membership): Eligibility and benefits for founders, co-founders, majority shareholders, and partners looking to join EO Bangalore.
- [Chapter Officers](https://eobangalore.com/chapter-officers): The chapter's board and leadership team.
- [My EO](https://eobangalore.com/my-eo): Member-driven My EO groups and forums for shared interests and deeper engagement.

## Programmes & Events

- [GSEA](https://eobangalore.com/gsea): The Global Student Entrepreneur Awards — EO's programme for student entrepreneurs.
- [RIE RIEMIX](https://www.rie2025.com/): EO's Regional Integration Event.

## Industries Represented

- Members span Real Estate, Pharmaceutical, Automotive, Apparel, Manufacturing, Distribution, Engineering, Biotechnology, Information Technology, Education, Hospitality, Finance & Insurance, Legal, and Transportation.

## Contact

- [Contact Us](https://eobangalore.com/contact-us): Enquiry form — inquiries answered within 24 hours on business days.
- [Privacy Policy](https://eobangalore.com/privacy-policy)
